text.p: Medical Resources Management Inc said it signed letters of intent to acquire Med Surg Specialties and SurgiCare Services.
These acquisitions will be in exchange for a combination of cash and common stock. Further terms were not disclosed.

The acquisitions are subject to approval by the board of directors for each company. Med Surg Specialties is a provider of mobile laser/surgical services in the greater Orange County area and reported unaudited 1996 revenues of about $1 million.
SurgiCare Services is a development stage company with an exclusive five-year contract to repair endoscopes for hospitals owned by Tenet Healthsystems Medical Inc.
